name: KuuOS Control Plane
description: Fail-closed KuuOS policy gate and post-effect receipt bridge for OpenClaw tools.

policyUrl.description: KuuOS control service base URL. Loopback is required unless allowRemotePolicyUrl is true.

policyToken.description: Optional bearer token for the KuuOS policy service.

allowRemotePolicyUrl.description: Permit non-loopback KuuOS policy service URLs. Off by default.

failClosed.description: Block tool calls when KuuOS preflight cannot be reached or returns an invalid decision.
